about: Sayings about beauty shown while Beljour loads: traditional proverbs, or lines by authors who died before 1929 and works first published before 1929. Each was checked against a source listed in docs/QUOTES-SOURCES.md. The English meanings are our own short wording, not copied translations. Author: John Khan.

quotes.text:
यद्यद्विभूतिमत्सत्त्वं श्रीमदूर्जितमेव वा ।
तत्तदेवावगच्छ त्वं मम तेजोंऽशसम्भवम् ॥
quotes.meaning: Whatever is glorious, lovely or strong, know that it rises from a spark of my splendour.
quotes.romanisation: yad yad vibhūtimat sattvaṃ śrīmad ūrjitam eva vā / tat tad evāvagaccha tvaṃ mama tejo'ṃśa-sambhavam

quotes.text: यदुच्यते पार्वति पापवृत्तये न रूपमित्यव्यभिचारि तद्वचः।
quotes.meaning: Parvati, the saying that beauty does not lead to wrongdoing holds true.
quotes.romanisation: yad ucyate pārvati pāpavṛttaye na rūpam ity avyabhicāri tad vacaḥ

quotes.text:
रूपयौवनसम्पन्ना विशालकुलसम्भवाः ।
विद्याहीना न शोभन्ते निर्गन्धाः किंशुका यथा ॥
quotes.meaning: Beauty, youth and a great family do not shine without learning, like kimshuka flowers that have no scent.
quotes.romanisation: rūpa-yauvana-sampannā viśāla-kula-sambhavāḥ / vidyā-hīnā na śobhante nirgandhāḥ kiṃśukā yathā

quotes.text: क्षीयन्ते खलु भूषणानि सततं वाग्भूषणं भूषणम्
quotes.meaning: Jewels wear away in time; fine speech is the ornament that lasts.
quotes.romanisation: kṣīyante khalu bhūṣaṇāni satataṃ vāg-bhūṣaṇaṃ bhūṣaṇam

quotes.text: विद्या नाम नरस्य रूपमधिकं प्रच्छन्नगुप्तं धनं
quotes.meaning: Learning is a person's finer beauty, a treasure kept safe out of sight.
quotes.romanisation: vidyā nāma narasya rūpam adhikaṃ pracchanna-guptaṃ dhanaṃ

quotes.text:
பிணையேர் மடநோக்கும் நாணும் உடையாட்கு
அணியெவனோ ஏதில தந்து.
quotes.meaning: She has a fawn's soft gaze and a modest grace; what could borrowed ornaments add?
quotes.romanisation: piṇaiyēr maṭanōkkum nāṇum uṭaiyāṭku / aṇiyevaṉō ētila tantu

quotes.text:
அணங்குகொல் ஆய்மயில் கொல்லோ கனங்குழை
மாதர்கொல் மாலும் என் நெஞ்சு.
quotes.meaning: A goddess? A rare peacock? A woman in heavy earrings? My heart is lost in wonder.
quotes.romanisation: aṇaṅkukol āymayil kollō kaṉaṅkuḻai / mātarkol mālum eṉ neñcu

quotes.text: 毛嬙、麗姬，人之所美也；魚見之深入，鳥見之高飛，麋鹿見之決驟，四者孰知天下之正色哉？
quotes.meaning: People find Mao Qiang and Li Ji beautiful, yet fish dive, birds fly off and deer run when they see them. Which of the four knows the one true beauty?
quotes.by: Zhuangzi, On the Equality of Things
quotes.romanisation: Máo Qiáng, Lì Jī, rén zhī suǒ měi yě; yú jiàn zhī shēn rù, niǎo jiàn zhī gāo fēi, mílù jiàn zhī jué zòu, sì zhě shú zhī tiānxià zhī zhèngsè zāi?

quotes.text: 天下皆知美之為美，斯惡已。
quotes.meaning: Once everyone names one thing beautiful, ugliness has already been made.
quotes.romanisation: Tiānxià jiē zhī měi zhī wéi měi, sī è yǐ.

quotes.text: 繪事後素。
quotes.meaning: The colours come after the plain silk.
quotes.romanisation: Huì shì hòu sù.

quotes.text:
雲想衣裳花想容，
春風拂檻露華濃。
quotes.meaning: Clouds bring her robes to mind, and flowers her face; the spring wind brushes the railing, heavy with bright dew.
quotes.romanisation: Yún xiǎng yīshang huā xiǎng róng, chūnfēng fú jiàn lù huá nóng.

quotes.text: 情人眼裡出西施
quotes.meaning: In a lover's eyes, the beloved is as lovely as Xi Shi.
quotes.romanisation: qíngrén yǎnlǐ chū Xīshī

quotes.text: 花は盛りに、月は隈なきをのみ見るものかは。
quotes.meaning: Are we to look at blossoms only in full bloom, and at the moon only when no cloud crosses it?
quotes.romanisation: Hana wa sakari ni, tsuki wa kuma naki o nomi miru mono ka wa.

quotes.text: 春はあけぼの。やうやう白くなりゆく山ぎは、すこし明かりて、紫だちたる雲の細くたなびきたる。
quotes.meaning: In spring, the dawn: the edge of the hills slowly whitening, a little light, and thin clouds tinged with purple trailing across.
quotes.romanisation: Haru wa akebono. Yōyō shiroku nariyuku yamagiwa, sukoshi akarite, murasaki-dachitaru kumo no hosoku tanabikitaru.

quotes.text: 立てば芍薬座れば牡丹歩く姿は百合の花
quotes.meaning: Standing, a peony; seated, a tree peony; walking, a lily in flower.
quotes.romanisation: Tateba shakuyaku, suwareba botan, aruku sugata wa yuri no hana

quotes.text: 蓼食う虫も好き好き
quotes.meaning: Even the insect that eats bitter smartweed has its own taste: to each their own.
quotes.romanisation: Tade kuu mushi mo sukizuki

quotes.text: 보기 좋은 떡이 먹기도 좋다
quotes.meaning: The rice cake that looks good also tastes good.
quotes.romanisation: Bogi joeun tteogi meokgido jota

quotes.text: 제 눈에 안경이다
quotes.meaning: Everyone looks through their own glasses: beauty is in the eye of the one who looks.
quotes.romanisation: Je nune angyeongida

quotes.text: שְׁחֹורָה אֲנִי וְנָאוָה בְּנֹות יְרוּשָׁלִָם
quotes.meaning: I am dark, and I am lovely, daughters of Jerusalem.
quotes.romanisation: Shəḥorah ani vənavah, bənot Yərushalayim

quotes.text: כֻּלָּךְ יָפָה רַעְיָתִי וּמוּם אֵין בָּךְ
quotes.meaning: You are lovely through and through, my love; there is no flaw in you.
quotes.romanisation: Kullakh yafah raʿyati, umum ein bakh

quotes.text: אֶת־הַכֹּל עָשָׂה יָפֶה בְעִתֹּו
quotes.meaning: Everything is made beautiful in its own time.
quotes.romanisation: Et-hakkol ʿasah yafeh vəʿitto

quotes.text:
اگر آن تُرکِ شیرازی به دست آرَد دلِ ما را
به خال هِندویَش بَخشَم سَمَرقند و بُخارا را
quotes.meaning: If that beauty of Shiraz would take my heart in her hand, I would give Samarkand and Bukhara for the dark mole on her cheek.
quotes.romanisation: Agar ān Tork-e Shirāzi be dast ārad del-e mā rā / be khāl-e hendu-yash bakhsham Samarqand o Bokhārā rā

quotes.text:
روی تو خوش می‌نماید آینهٔ ما
کآینه پاکیزه است و روی تو زیبا
quotes.meaning: Your face looks lovely in our mirror, for the mirror is clean and your face is beautiful.
quotes.romanisation: Ru-ye to khosh mi-nemāyad āyene-ye mā / k-āyene pākize ast o ru-ye to zibā

quotes.text:
نازکی اس کے لب کی کیا کہئے
پنکھڑی اک گلاب کی سی ہے
quotes.meaning: How can I tell how delicate her lips are? Like a single petal of a rose.
quotes.romanisation: nāzukī us ke lab kī kyā kahiye / pañkhuṛī ik gulāb kī sī hai

quotes.text:
ان کے دیکھے سے جو آ جاتی ہے منہ پر رونق
وہ سمجھتے ہیں کہ بیمار کا حال اچھا ہے
quotes.meaning: Seeing her brings a glow to my face, and she thinks the sick man must be getting better.
quotes.romanisation: un ke dekhe se jo ā jātī hai muñh par raunaq / vo samajhte haiñ ki bīmār kā hāl achchhā hai

quotes.text:
آئینہ کیوں نہ دوں کہ تماشا کہیں جسے
ایسا کہاں سے لاؤں کہ تجھ سا کہیں جسے
quotes.meaning: Why not give you a mirror, a sight worth seeing? Where else would I find anyone like you?
quotes.romanisation: āʾīna kyūñ na dūñ ki tamāshā kaheñ jise / aisā kahāñ se lāʾūñ ki tujh sā kaheñ jise

quotes.text: إِنَّ اللَّهَ جَمِيلٌ يُحِبُّ الْجَمَالَ
quotes.meaning: God is beautiful and loves beauty.
quotes.romanisation: Inna Allāha jamīlun yuḥibbu al-jamāl

quotes.text: القرد في عين أمه غزال
quotes.meaning: In its mother's eyes, the monkey is a gazelle.
quotes.romanisation: Al-qird fī ʿayn ummihi ghazāl

quotes.text: दूर के ढोल सुहावने लगते हैं
quotes.meaning: Drums sound sweet from far away.
quotes.romanisation: Dūr ke ḍhol suhāvane lagte haiñ

quotes.text:
ὀ μὲν γὰρ κάλος ὄσσον ἴδην πέλεται,
ὀ δὲ κἄγαθος αὔτικα καὶ κάλος ἔσσεται.
quotes.meaning: The handsome are lovely only to look at; the good will soon be lovely too.
quotes.romanisation: ho men gar kalos osson idēn peletai, / ho de kagathos autika kai kalos essetai.

quotes.text: ἐπὶ γᾶν μέλαιναν ἔμμεναι κάλλιστον, ἐγὼ δὲ κῆν’ ὄττω τις ἔραται
quotes.meaning: The most beautiful thing on the dark earth? I say it is whatever you love.
quotes.romanisation: epi gān melainan emmenai kalliston, egō de kēn’ ottō tis eratai

quotes.text: Forma bonum fragile est.
quotes.meaning: Beauty is a fragile gift.

quotes.text: Ingenii dotes corporis adde bonis.
quotes.meaning: To the gifts of the body, add the gifts of the mind.

quotes.text: Pulchra enim dicuntur quae visa placent.
quotes.meaning: We call beautiful the things that please us when we see them.

quotes.text:
A thing of beauty is a joy for ever:
Its loveliness increases; it will never
Pass into nothingness
quotes.meaning: Beautiful things keep giving joy, and their loveliness only grows.

quotes.text: Beauty is truth, truth beauty
quotes.meaning: What is beautiful is true, and what is true is beautiful.
quotes.by: John Keats, Ode on a Grecian Urn

quotes.text:
Beauty is bought by judgement of the eye,
Not utter'd by base sale of chapmen's tongues
quotes.meaning: Beauty is judged by the eye that sees it, not sold by a trader's patter.

quotes.text:
Mignonne, allons voir si la rose
Qui ce matin avoit desclose
Sa robe de pourpre au Soleil
quotes.meaning: Darling, let us go and see whether the rose that opened its crimson gown to the sun this morning still blooms.

quotes.text:
Tanto gentile e tanto onesta pare
la donna mia quand'ella altrui saluta
quotes.meaning: So gracious and so modest my lady seems when she greets someone.

quotes.text: Non è bello quel che è bello ma è bello ciò che piace
quotes.meaning: Beautiful is not what is called beautiful, but what pleases you.

quotes.text: Anche l'occhio vuole la sua parte
quotes.meaning: The eye wants its share too.

quotes.text: La cara es el espejo del alma.
quotes.meaning: The face is the mirror of the soul.

quotes.text: Quem ama o feio, bonito lhe parece.
quotes.meaning: Whoever loves someone plain finds them beautiful.

quotes.text: Auch das Schöne muss sterben!
quotes.meaning: Even what is beautiful must die.

quotes.text:
Werd ich zum Augenblicke sagen:
Verweile doch! du bist so schön!
quotes.meaning: If ever I say to the moment: stay a while, you are so beautiful!

quotes.text: Go minic ní bhíonn áilleacht ach ar an taobh amuigh.
quotes.meaning: Often, beauty is only on the outside.

quotes.text: Mzuri hakosi kilema.
quotes.meaning: No beautiful person is without a blemish.

quotes.text: Uzuri wategemea mtazamaji.
quotes.meaning: Beauty depends on the one who looks.

quotes.text: Ìwà l’ẹ̀wà.
quotes.meaning: Character is beauty.

quotes.text: Ikhiwane elihle ligcwala izibungu.
quotes.meaning: A beautiful fig may be full of worms.

quotes.text: Gönül kimi severse güzel odur.
quotes.meaning: Whoever the heart loves, that one is beautiful.

quotes.text: Güzel yüzden kırk günde usanılır, güzel huydan kırk yılda usanılmaz.
quotes.meaning: One tires of a pretty face in forty days, but not of a kind nature in forty years.

quotes.text: Tốt gỗ hơn tốt nước sơn.
quotes.meaning: Good wood matters more than a good coat of paint.

quotes.text:
Làn thu thủy, nét xuân sơn,
Hoa ghen thua thắm, liễu hờn kém xanh.
quotes.meaning: Eyes clear as autumn water, brows like spring hills; flowers envied her colour, and willows sulked at being less green.
quotes.by: Nguyen Du, The Tale of Kieu

quotes.text:
Я помню чудное мгновенье:
Передо мной явилась ты,
Как мимолетное виденье,
Как гений чистой красоты.
quotes.meaning: I remember a wondrous moment: you appeared before me like a passing vision, like the spirit of pure beauty.
quotes.romanisation: Ya pomnyu chudnoye mgnovenye: / Peredo mnoy yavilas' ty, / Kak mimolyotnoye viden'ye, / Kak geniy chistoy krasoty.

quotes.text: Будь красив, да не будь спесив.
quotes.meaning: Be handsome, but don't be vain.
quotes.romanisation: Bud' krasiv, da ne bud' spesiv.

quotes.text: ไก่งามเพราะขน คนงามเพราะแต่ง
quotes.meaning: A hen is lovely for its feathers, a person for how they dress.
quotes.romanisation: gài ngaam prór kŏn, kon ngaam prór dtàeng
